Prior condition: Customer account is active, travel service exists
Input data: Traveler details valid, service ID valid
Step: 1. Customer selects travel service and enters traveler details; 2. System calculates total amount with tax/discount; 3. Customer confirms booking
Expected result: Booking is created successfully; Booking status = "Pending Payment"; Record appears in booking history

Description: Booking creation with invalid traveler details
Prior condition: Customer account is active, travel service exists
Input data: Missing passport number in traveler details
Step: 1. Customer selects travel service but enters incomplete traveler info; 2. System validates input; 3. Customer attempts to confirm booking
Expected result: System rejects the booking creation; Validation error message displayed: "Traveler details are required"; No booking record saved

Prior condition: A booking exists with status = "Pending Payment"
Step: 1. Customer edits booking to change number of travelers; 2. System recalculates total amount; 3. Customer saves updated booking
Expected result: Booking record updated with new traveler count; Updated total amount is correct; Status remains "Pending Payment"

Prior condition: A booking exists with status = "Pending Payment"
Step: 1. Customer clicks “Cancel Booking”; 2. System asks for confirmation; 3. Customer confirms cancellation
Expected result: Booking status updated to "Cancelled"; No payment required; Record available in booking history with "Cancelled" status

Description: Attempt to update/cancel booking after payment
Step: 1. Customer tries to change traveler count; 2. Customer tries to cancel booking
Expected result: System rejects both operations; Error message displayed: "Cannot update/cancel booking after payment"; Booking record remains unchanged
